comparators.trigger: RailwaySavedData graph-first train restore then actual Train.tick and Carriage/TravellingPoint steering
comparators.input: Selected station UUID, ordered future junction node pairs, signed direction/distances and blocking signal UUID/side/wait ticks
comparators.output: Full Navigation923 read including route generation, signal scanning/braking, write/read and selectors. Real RailwaySavedData loads graphs before trains; Train reconstructs Navigation using loaded graph. Destination UUID resolves actual current station or disables navigation; saved ordered junction node location pairs resolve live nodes, remove null entries, restore distance/direction and waiting signal UUID/side/distance/ticks. Actual global manager installs loaded trains initially moving, earlyTick/tick calls train.navigation.tick; current signal occupancy is revalidated, scouts/chained-group map reconstructed instead of serializing object pointers. Actual Carriage.travel selects Navigation.control for leading wheel, TravellingPoint.travel invokes selector at >1 branch, Navigation.navigateOptions matches current live graph edge to first saved path pair and consumes entry, else first option fallback. Active waiting signal plus restored distance governs braking/stop and true frontSignalListener stops at matching signal; destination crossing arrives and clears route. Thus serialized route is actual operator intent at future junctions and waiting policy, not inert render data or only entity position. Whole actualroute owner upperbound1, helpers0.
comparators.preservation: Full Navigation persistence and actual future-junction control/braking consumers independently read. Unlike f729 owned vehicle identity/passenger reconstruction, this preserves operator-selected future turns rather than physical train position. Unlike f550 itinerary instruction completion, it restores concrete currently selected route and red-signal braking state; unlike a781 all-wheel topology preflight, null route entries are discarded and mismatched junction falls back to first option rather than retaining failed wheel checkpoint. Whole route/wait checkpoint1; helper/pathfinding/field/graph wrapper0.
comparators.application_limit: Not earned quest progress/paid reward transaction. This is route intent and transient operational waiting checkpoint; references distinguish durable authored task/vehicle ownership from state that must revalidate current topology/occupancy. No historic schema/version migrator proven beyond optional keys and current reconstruction. Destination missing or graph null returns early before clearing currentPath/wait fields; fresh Navigation defaults empty/null, reused instance could retain stale residual fields while inactive. No opaque destination tombstone for station restored later; next save of inactive Navigation empty loses intent. removeBrokenPathEntries drops null node pairs but does not check edge connectivity or continuous planned path. navigateOptions on no saved match selects options[0] rather than stop/retain checkpoint; at junction unexpected topology can steer another route. Generic map order not asserted deterministic. Distinct a781 preserves failed full-wheel checkpoints; this route policy is deliberately weaker. Read path list delegates Couple/NBTHelper and palette readers not fully audited here; malformed UUID, wrongtag, pair lengths, NaN/negative/huge distances/ticks not validated locally. Missing wait distance/ticks defaults0 can alter braking immediately. waitingForChainedGroups not persisted and begins empty; currentSignalResolved cross-signal loop can return true on empty map before scout rebuild. No guarantee exact red-cross-signal wait restored on first tick, no freeze of old reservations. Global manager clears group.trains/reserved per tick and rebuilds earlyTick; full earlyTick/SignalEdgeGroup ownership engine not reread in this receipt. Navigation.curve scan computes turn.starts before turn!=null guard; source TravellingPoint only invokes supplied turnListener after edge.isTurn but full edge/getTurn invariant not read. Do not claim proven runtime NPE or validation passes. Navigation startNavigation mutates path/distance/clears signal state before conductor validation; failure may leave earlier destination with replaced path. cancelNavigation with null destination returns before reserved clearing. Reader/writer mutate state, no transaction/rollback. write removes broken path entries from actual live list before saving; absent destination emits empty compound. No per-field markdirty; actual Train.tick calls markTracksDirty externally, native SavedData disk atomicity and file durable ack not audited. No actual game/reload test. Saved ticksWaitingForSignal biases route cost; fullRefresh can call runtime.startCurrentInstruction to select a new route; saved path is not a fixed guarantee. Signals unresolved/missing may be treated passable, destination deleted terminates restoration. Full schedule engine is comparator support, not newly credited. Fixed modern snapshot not Forge1.20.1 API compatibility proof. No network/production/checklist/ledger edits/commit/push.
